jobs.title: Remote Sensing & Spectral Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Oxus Metals AI is a Singapore headquartered, AI native company dedicated to advancing data and artificial intelligence solutions for critical mineral discovery. We are seeking a Remote Sensing & Spectral Data Engineer
to support advanced mineral exploration projects, with a focus on copper, lithium, and other critical minerals.

We offer competitive cash compensation plus stock options.

Key Responsibilities

Raw Data Processing:
Process multi source satellite, airborne, and ground based hyperspectral and multispectral raw data, including radiometric calibration, atmospheric correction, geometric correction, and orthorectification.
Mineral Exploration & Interpretation:
Apply hyperspectral and multispectral remote sensing to spectral analysis, mineral mapping, and alteration mapping, with a focus on copper, lithium, and other critical minerals.
Multi Source Data Integration:
Work with the AI team to integrate remote sensing results with geophysical, geochemical, and geological data for AI predictive models.
Workflow Optimization & Automation:
Develop and optimize standardized workflows for remote sensing data processing and mineral information extraction. Improve automation through programming and scripting.
Technical Reporting & Support:
Prepare remote sensing geological interpretation reports and provide technical support for field exploration and drill target delineation.

Preferred Qualifications

Education:
Master’s degree or above in Remote Sensing, GIS, Geology, Earth Exploration & Information Technology, or a related field. Exceptional Bachelor’s candidates will also be considered.
Remote Sensing & GIS Skills:
Proficiency in ENVI, ArcGIS/ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, SNAP, eCognition
, or similar software. Strong experience with hyperspectral, multispectral, and SAR data processing, including complete processing and analysis from raw data.
Programming Skills:
Proficiency in Python
and experience with geospatial libraries such as GDAL, Rasterio, ArcPy, or PyQGIS
. Ability to develop scripts for batch processing and workflow automation.
Industry Experience:
Experience in mineral exploration, geological mapping, or remote sensing geological interpretation is preferred. Familiarity with spectral signatures and alteration mapping for copper and lithium mineral systems is highly desirable.
Language:
Strong English communication skills, with the ability to read technical literature and prepare technical reports in English.
Preferred:
Field geology experience and the ability to correlate remote sensing interpretations with geological outcrops.
Soft Skills:
Strong independent problem solving skills, teamwork, and cross disciplinary communication.

jobs.title: Senior Remote Sensing Technical Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Company

We simplify the adoption of geospatial data to understand better the world and enable people to act in an aware and timely manner to live better and preserve the Earth.

Planetek Hellas
operates in many fields of application ranging from environmental and land monitoring to open-government and smart cities, including defense and security as well as scientific missions and planetary exploration.

We deal with the continuous monitoring with satellite data of Earth’s surface, infrastructures, worksites, urban dynamics, or marine coastal areas in support of decision-making and operational activities. We develop on-board software for satellites and data processing solutions for ground segment infrastructures. Our involvement in research and development activities supports the human exploration of the solar system. We develop Spatial Data Infrastructure (SDI) in compliance with INSPIRE as well as solutions for Smart City and complex systems to support decisions that exploit geographic information and Earth observation data, according to the new paradigms of Cloud and Software As a Service.

Our focus on innovation has recently generated Rheticus®, a cloud platform designed to provide accurate data and real-time information about our changing world for the public and private sectors working to preserve our planet and improve the quality of our lives. This new type of service has led to a decisive transformation of the business model in geo-information services and today represents the synthesis of Planetek Italia’s skills and ability in producing high value-added services.

Your Role as a Senior Remote Sensing Technical Specialist

As a Senior
Remote Sensing Technical Specialist
, you will develop innovative applications and services for geospatial projects, leveraging your expertise in remote sensing technologies. Your role will involve processing and analyzing Earth observation data using specialized software and custom tools.

We seek proactive individuals with a solution-driven mindset who thrive in dynamic environments. In return, you will join a motivated and highly skilled team, contributing to the company's growth and success.

Key Responsibilities:

Remote Sensing Expertise:
Utilize your deep understanding of optical, SAR, and hyperspectral remote sensing to analyze and process geospatial data.

Software Proficiency:
Employ EO software such as ERDAS Imagine, QGIS, and ArcGIS to manage and interpret geospatial datasets.

Technical Documentation:
Develop reports, publications, and project proposals related to EO applications.

Collaboration:
Work with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders to ensure the successful execution of projects.

Additional Responsibilities:

Implement AI-based solutions for EO data analysis using frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

Utilize cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for EO data processing and accessibility.

Apply expertise in EO data formats and processing tools to enhance analytical capabilities.

Engage with Data and Information Access Services (DIAS) to facilitate seamless EO data sharing.

Required Background & Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Surveying Engineering, Forestry, Environmental Science, Geography, Physical Sciences, or Geology.

A Master’s degree in Geoinformatics or Computer Vision is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Solid knowledge of EO (multispectral, SAR), including data management and metadata.

Hands-on experience with geospatial data processing and AI (ML/DL) applications.

Proficiency in scripting and spatial data analysis using Python or other programming languages.

Language Skills:

Fluency in Greek and English.

Additional Skills:

Ability to multitask under tight deadlines.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Effective communication and teamwork abilities.

What We Offer

At Planetek Hellas
, we prioritize results and value individuals for their passion and sense of responsibility. Ethics, professionalism, and teamwork define our work culture. If you are looking for a company that fosters enthusiasm and innovation, join us to contribute to the advancement of geospatial technologies.

Your office will be based in Marousi (Athens), with the flexibility to work remotely three days a week. Occasional travel across Europe may be required.

Why Work With Us?

We recognize that exceptional work comes from a diverse and talented team. Our inclusive culture ensures that everyone feels valued and empowered to innovate. We invest in our employees’ professional growth through workshops, conferences, and training opportunities. Compensation packages will be tailored based on experience and needs .

Position Description

The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at the University of California, Berkeley, seeks an Assistant/Associate Project Scientist to work with Professor Kenichi Soga on performance-based monitoring and risk assessment tool of lifeline infrastructure systems as part of research projects funded by the California Energy Commission, Los Angeles Department of Water and Power and East Bay Municipal Utility District in Professor Kenichi Soga's lab entitled "Center for Smart Infrastructure". In particular, the project scientist will work on a ground hazard risk assessment framework using embedded sensor systems for energy and water infrastructure systems as well as its implementation under the guidance of Professor Soga. The outcome of the research will serve the infrastructure engineering community, leveraging real-time monitoring technologies to reduce construction and operational costs.

The position will involve

Conducting laboratory and field experiments in the area of infrastructure sensing, such as distributed fiber optic sensors and wireless sensor network
Analyzing data obtained from the experiments
Writing reports from the investigation
Organizing meetings with the funding agencies
Tracking and managing the day-to-day operation of the Berkeley Center for Smart Infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Job Description

The Office of Building Water System Oversight (BWSO) within the Bureau of Environmental Sciences and Engineering (ESE) is responsible for The conducting inspections to ensure compliance with various rules and regulations aimed at improving the operating conditions of various engineered systems such as cooling towers, water tanks, evaporative condensers, internal plumbing, and wastewater systems in order to prevent risks associated with these systems

Duties Will Include But Not Be Limited To

Under supervision, conduct field inspections that include travel through the five boroughs to various building types for building water supply and distribution systems such as cooling towers, evaporative condensers, building plumbing, and wastewater systems.

Under supervision, field inspections will include review of water management plans, equipment operation records, physical inspection of mechanical and chemical treatment equipment, water sample collection and water quality analysis.
Under supervision, generate and submit field inspection reports according to the Bureau's inspection protocols and conduct follow up compliance inspections, as needed, to mitigate potential risks. to the public.
Under supervision, assist with customer service to our regulated community including building owners, facility maintenance personnel, superintendents, and any other responsible parties.
Assist in providing recommendations to improve regulatory compliance and corrective actions to eliminate environmental health hazards promptly in accordance with the NYC and NYS regulations.
Review inspection findings and prepare necessary evidence used by the Department at the Office of Administrative Tribunal Hearings convened to adjudicate notice of violations and summonses.
Assist with rapid response to signals triggered by the Department's Legionnaires' disease surveillance system and implement our response protocol.
Prepare water samples for drop off or shipping to analytical laboratories including completion of all necessary laboratory forms and documents.
Conduct field surveys associated with identifying potential risks for Legionella exposure. Review process schematics, engineering plans, drawings and specifications for cooling tower systems and building water supply and distribution systems.

Preferred Skills

Academic background in environmental or chemical engineering, limnology, environmental science, marine science, geology, biology, earth science, chemistry, physics, or health science.
Prefer to work in the field including travel throughout the five boroughs.
Must be able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces, work in high altitudes (building roofs) to perform field inspections and water testing.
Knowledge or study in hazard mitigation, risk assessment, environmental investigations, or public health.
Pass medical clearance and FIT testing for wearing proper PPE respirators. Must complete and pass Agency required trainings and be in compliance with the position related certificates and licenses.
Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
Ability to perform data entry and navigate inspection programs on a portable device (iPhone or Tablet).
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, Access).

Why You Should Work For Us

Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:
a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position's associated union/benefit fund.
a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
a tax-deferred savings program and
a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.
Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

Job Title:
Offshore Data Processor

Duration:
1 year

Schedule:
Offshore and office-based

Location:
France and offshore assignments

This opportunity sits within offshore survey studies and focuses on the processing, quality control and delivery of survey and positioning data, with particular emphasis on multibeam datasets. The role supports technically demanding project work across office and offshore operations, with scope to contribute to data integrity, reporting and geodetic implementation. It is well suited to candidates with strong offshore data processing expertise, survey software capability and experience working in Oil & Gas environments.

Key Responsibilities

Process survey and positioning data, including multibeam data, in line with project requirements.
Assist with the installation of survey and positioning equipment and software systems.
Support calibration and verification of sensors in coordination with Online Surveyors.
Install and configure data processing systems and computer hardware.
Connect data processing systems to online systems, printers and data archiving systems.
Check data flow, storage, formatting and overall data quality.
Plan data processing workflows to support efficient project delivery.
Process, format and prepare reports from acquired survey data.
Prepare and verify project databases and reference files, ensuring current versions are used.
Ensure correct implementation of geodetic parameters in data processing and mapping procedures.
Assess work progress and report issues, including where re-surveys or infill surveys may be required.
Ensure survey data is stored correctly and backed up appropriately.
Maintain records to support traceability from data acquisition through to final delivery.
Carry out quality control of processed datasets against project acceptance criteria and procedures.
Forecast tide levels using harmonic constituents and cotidal data.
Compile survey reports with input from other survey disciplines.
Provide a detailed final report on data issues encountered and the solutions implemented.
Check and verify charts, digital deliverables and field reports as required.
Monitor real-time data acquisition in coordination with the Online Surveyor.

Required Education & Certifications

Bachelor of Science or Master of Science degree (Required)
BOSIET (OPITO) + CA-EBS certification (Required)
Valid Medical Fitness Certificate (Required)

Required Experience

Experience within Offshore Survey studies
Experience working in the Oil & Gas industry
Experience supporting offshore or office-based survey data processing operations

Required Skills

Proficiency in English, both written and spoken
Proficiency in Eiva NaviEdit
Proficiency in NaviModel
Strong survey and positioning data processing capability
Ability to perform quality control on processed datasets and deliverables
Ability to manage geodetic parameters within data processing and mapping procedures

About the Company

We simplify the adoption of geospatial data to understand better the world and enable people to act in an aware and timely manner to live better and preserve the Earth.

Planetek Hellas
operates in many fields of application ranging from environmental and land monitoring to open-government and smart cities, including defense and security as well as scientific missions and planetary exploration.

We deal with the continuous monitoring with satellite data of Earth’s surface, infrastructures, worksites, urban dynamics, or marine coastal areas in support of decision-making and operational activities. We develop on-board software for satellites and data processing solutions for ground segment infrastructures. Our involvement in research and development activities supports the human exploration of the solar system. We develop Spatial Data Infrastructure (SDI) in compliance with INSPIRE as well as solutions for Smart City and complex systems to support decisions that exploit geographic information and Earth observation data, according to the new paradigms of Cloud and Software As a Service.

Our focus on innovation has recently generated Rheticus®, a cloud platform designed to provide accurate data and real-time information about our changing world for the public and private sectors working to preserve our planet and improve the quality of our lives. This new type of service has led to a decisive transformation of the business model in geo-information services and today represents the synthesis of Planetek Italia’s skills and ability in producing high value-added services.

Your Role as a Senior Remote Sensing Technical Specialist

As a Senior
Remote Sensing Technical Specialist
, you will develop innovative applications and services for geospatial projects, leveraging your expertise in remote sensing technologies. Your role will involve processing and analyzing Earth observation data using specialized software and custom tools.

We seek proactive individuals with a solution-driven mindset who thrive in dynamic environments. In return, you will join a motivated and highly skilled team, contributing to the company's growth and success.

Key Responsibilities:

Remote Sensing Expertise:
Utilize your deep understanding of optical, SAR, and hyperspectral remote sensing to analyze and process geospatial data.

Software Proficiency:
Employ EO software such as ERDAS Imagine, QGIS, and ArcGIS to manage and interpret geospatial datasets.

Technical Documentation:
Develop reports, publications, and project proposals related to EO applications.

Collaboration:
Work with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders to ensure the successful execution of projects.

Additional Responsibilities:

Implement AI-based solutions for EO data analysis using frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

Utilize cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for EO data processing and accessibility.

Apply expertise in EO data formats and processing tools to enhance analytical capabilities.

Engage with Data and Information Access Services (DIAS) to facilitate seamless EO data sharing.

Required Background & Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Surveying Engineering, Forestry, Environmental Science, Geography, Physical Sciences, or Geology.

A Master’s degree in Geoinformatics or Computer Vision is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Solid knowledge of EO (multispectral, SAR), including data management and metadata.

Hands-on experience with geospatial data processing and AI (ML/DL) applications.

Proficiency in scripting and spatial data analysis using Python or other programming languages.

Language Skills:

Fluency in Greek and English.

Additional Skills:

Ability to multitask under tight deadlines.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Effective communication and teamwork abilities.

What We Offer

At Planetek Hellas
, we prioritize results and value individuals for their passion and sense of responsibility. Ethics, professionalism, and teamwork define our work culture. If you are looking for a company that fosters enthusiasm and innovation, join us to contribute to the advancement of geospatial technologies.

Your office will be based in Marousi (Athens), with the flexibility to work remotely three days a week. Occasional travel across Europe may be required.

Why Work With Us?

We recognize that exceptional work comes from a diverse and talented team. Our inclusive culture ensures that everyone feels valued and empowered to innovate. We invest in our employees’ professional growth through workshops, conferences, and training opportunities. Compensation packages will be tailored based on experience and needs .

The Office of Building Water System Oversight (BWSO) within the Bureau of Environmental Sciences and Engineering (ESE) is responsible for The conducting inspections to ensure compliance with various rules and regulations aimed at improving the operating conditions of various engineered systems such as cooling towers, water tanks, evaporative condensers, internal plumbing, and wastewater systems in order to prevent risks associated with these systems

Under supervision, conduct field inspections that include travel through the five boroughs to various building types for building water supply and distribution systems such as cooling towers, evaporative condensers, building plumbing, and wastewater systems.

Under supervision, field inspections will include review of water management plans, equipment operation records, physical inspection of mechanical and chemical treatment equipment, water sample collection and water quality analysis.
Under supervision, generate and submit field inspection reports according to the Bureau's inspection protocols and conduct follow up compliance inspections, as needed, to mitigate potential risks. to the public.
Under supervision, assist with customer service to our regulated community including building owners, facility maintenance personnel, superintendents, and any other responsible parties.

Prepare water samples for drop off or shipping to analytical laboratories including completion of all necessary laboratory forms and documents.
Conduct field surveys associated with identifying potential risks for Legionella exposure. Review process schematics, engineering plans, drawings and specifications for cooling tower systems and building water supply and distribution systems.
